findings.trigger: Parent invokes audit.py without first running audit_segment_streams.py, or the independent checker fails.
findings.consequence: audit.py writes the accepted terminal audit and clears the exact main-ledger lease without requiring the parent stream-audit receipt. The declared pre-release stream gate is therefore bypassable.
findings.required_fix: Make audit.py require and validate the parent stream-audit receipt, including registration and journal hashes and all ten verified segments, before writing parent-terminal-audit.json or clearing the lease.

findings.trigger: An assignment event or its rows are omitted from the hashed training journal while segment boundary records remain complete.
findings.consequence: Checker accepts zero or incomplete actual assignments: it validates each row present but never proves complete slot/episode assignment coverage. A partial stream audit can be marked passed, then used to release the lease.
findings.required_fix: Derive expected slot/episode assignments from each segment's start/end indices and require exact one-to-one coverage before publishing the passed receipt.

limits.review_type: static source and registration hash review
